newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-W jumps on PLN 70 mln deals.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-W jumps on PLN 70 mln deals.

text.p: Polish construction firm Mostostal Warszawa SA, one of Thursday's only three gainers, rose 4.3 percent to 14.5 zlotys in light 0.3-million-zloty trade after it won two deals worth 70-million-zlotys, traders said.
"It's the good contracts which caused the growth," one trader said.

Mostostal said on Wednesday it won a 50-million-zloty tender to expand the Warsaw headquarters of BGZ bank and on Tuesday it said it signed a deal worth 20 million zlotys on building facilities for Polish Post Office in Warsaw.
